Anna (People Ops): quick question — EMILY's baby went to NICU overnight and she might need to come back earlier than her planned parental leave end. what docs do we need to update? who signs off on shortened leave + any payroll adjustments? 

Michelle (People Ops): oh no, sending good vibes to Emily ❤️. if she's shortening the leave window we need an updated leave request + a medical note supporting the new return date. also confirm whether she wants to convert any remaining leave to intermittent or to use PTO for the overlap. 

Anna (People Ops): who does she send the medical note to? manager or HR inbox? and timeline — does payroll need it before the next paycycle? 

Michelle (People Ops): she can upload to the HR portal (Benefits > Leaves) or email hr@redwood-inference.com if she needs help. payroll needs the updated dates by the payroll cutoff (usually 5 business days before pay run) to avoid retro pay adjustments. if it's last-minute we'll do a retro adjustment but aim to get it in asap. 

Rob (Eng): for coverage, +1 to short-term handoff. Emily's manager can reassign critical tasks. I can pick up any routing policy PRs for the week. we should also flag any oncall shifts. 

Jess (Product): also check any scheduled customer demos she's running — we can reassign or have a backup join. Emily, if you're reading, want me to cover demos next week? :point_down: 

Emily (via Anna): she asked me to post that she'd prefer to keep benefits active and return asap, but she's unsure about paperwork. she said NICU stay is expected 10-14 days. 

Michelle (People Ops): ok, checklist for early return/no-gap: 1) updated leave request form with new end date; 2) medical note indicating anticipated discharge or ability to return; 3) confirm benefits continuation choice; 4) manager sign-off on ramp plan + oncall coverage; 5) notify payroll before cutoff. I'll paste an email template you can send Emily: 

```
Hi Emily — sending hugs. To update your planned leave, please reply with: 1) confirmed return date, 2) a medical note from your provider about discharge/return, and 3) whether you'd like to convert any remaining leave to PTO or intermittent leave. Upload docs to the HR portal or reply to this thread and we'll help. Payroll cutoff is {date}; if you can't make that we'll run a retro adjustment. — Michelle
```

Rob (Eng): small ops note — if she comes back part-time initially, please ask manager to mark "reduced hours" in the return plan so systems (oncall, access) are adjusted. 

TimeOffBot: Automated reminder — Payroll cutoff is in 6 business days (for pay period ending 1784124000). Submit updates at: https://hr.redwood-inference.com/leaves

Anna (People Ops): thanks all. I'll message Emily with the template and ping her manager for a quick ramp plan. I'll also flag payroll if dates look tight. :pray: 

Jess (Product): if Emily wants demo cover, I can take the Thurs slot. Rob, can you handle PRs Tues-Wed? 

Rob (Eng): yep I can. 

Michelle (People Ops): I'll monitor docs and confirm when payroll gets the update. please keep this thread short — LMK if anything changes.
